newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Budapest bourse suspends trading in Eravis.
newsitem.headline: Budapest bourse suspends trading in Eravis.

text.p: The Budapest Stock Exchange (BSE) said on Friday it suspended trading in hotelier Eravis shares for today following newspaper reports about an acquisition by Eravis in Hunguest Hotels Rt.
Media reports said on Friday a consortium led by Eravis had acquired a 50 percent stake in Hunguest Hotels Rt.

The bourse said it had suspended Eravis because the company had not informed it about the acquisition, while the newspaper reports were contradictory and they could influence investors in their decisions.
"Contradictory and unofficial information has been published which could substantially influence the value of the issuer's securities," the BSE said in a statement.
Some newspapers said the consortium of Eravis, Aquincum Rt and Pannon-Valto had acquired a 50 percent stake in Hunguest.
These reports did not disclose how the consortium members had shared the stake, while another paper said Eravis had acquired the full 50 percent.
The BSE said that, defending the interests of investors, it had suspended Eravis and asked the company to publish information about the acquisition officially.
